title: Keysa: Crack the Seed Game

prize.note: the author never published the escrow address; I found it by matching the announced amount, 369,369 sats, as a near-unique fingerprint in a full blockchain balance dump, then corroborated it by script type (v0_p2wpkh, matching BIP84) and by funding time (2 minutes 28 seconds after the announcement post)

target_format: BIP39 12 words (English), BIP84 m/84'/0'/0'/0/0, no passphrase

derivation.summary: select 12 of the 70 printed words in some order, derive the BIP84 first receiving address, and compare it to the escrow address
derivation.certified_against: the public BIP39/BIP84 test vector (mnemonic 'abandon' repeated 11 times plus 'about'), since no solved sibling exists for this puzzle

difficulty_note: the derivation is fully understood and the mechanical and structural search space is thoroughly mapped (669,858 positional readings, 479,001,600 orderings of the 12 dotless tokens, 572,368 semantic selections, 105 intrinsic-property criteria, 36 acrostic selections, all negative); the selection rule is described by the author as short, memorable, and meant to be spoken aloud to a trusted person, which argues the missing piece is an unrecovered insight or a fact only the author has stated, not more compute

leads.title: submit argued candidate 12-word orderings (the order-not-selection reading)
the double-width gap after mad, and the 369-clock theme

third_party_material: the two card images in clues/ are the author's own published puzzle material, posted on X and mirrored on nostr.build; her book and workshop materials are not included and are referenced by title only
